plan.title: 2023 Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends of annual giving by mode, city, and donor behavior

panels.title: Total Donations Received
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%'

panels.title: Average Donation Amount
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Amount") AS avg_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%'

panels.title: Number of Unique Donors
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS unique_donors FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%'

panels.title: Donation Amount by Payment Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Donation Amount by City
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE("Date")) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
